prompt: On the root sheet of pic_programmer.kicad_sch in this folder, add a 3.3 V supply taken from VCC: an AMS1117-3.3 regulator (library symbol `Regulator_Linear:AMS1117-3.3`, reference U7, footprint `Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-223-3_TabPin2`), a 10 uF input capacitor C10 from VCC to GND and a 22 uF output capacitor C11 from +3V3 to GND (symbol `Device:C`, footprint `Capacitor_SMD:C_0805_2012Metric`). Use power symbols for VCC, +3V3 and GND (`power:VCC`, `power:+3V3`, `power:GND`), not wires to the rest of the sheet. Lay it out cleanly in the empty area at the top right of the sheet, between x 190 and 280 mm and y 20 and 60 mm, on the 1.27 mm grid, with wires that connect every pin. ERC must show no new problems. Change nothing else, and save the schematic.

On the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder, the seven LED nets /LED1 to /LED7 (from U1 to the resistors R7 to R13) are not routed. Add a net class `LED` with a 0.2 mm track width and 0.15 mm clearance, assigned to the nets by the pattern `/LED*`, route all seven nets with 0.2 mm tracks (vias where you need them, at the default 0.5 mm / 0.3 mm), refill the copper pours and save. DRC must be clean afterwards: no unconnected items and no violations. Change nothing else.

On the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder, the decoupling capacitors C5, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C12 and C13 have been moved off the board, to the right of it. Place each of them back on the bottom side (B.Cu), next to the U1 pin it decouples, so that its power pad is within 2 mm of that pin: C5 pin 26, C6 pin 31, C7 pin 36, C8 pin 15, C9 pin 42, C10 pin 20, C12 pin 21, C13 pin 28. No courtyard may overlap another part's, and no capacitor pad may touch copper of another net. Don't route anything and don't move anything else; save the board.

In this pic_programmer project, change the footprint of the 10K resistors R1 to R7 to `Resistor_THT:R_Axial_DIN0207_L6.3mm_D2.5mm_P7.62mm_Horizontal`, and of C6 and C7 (they are on the pic_sockets sheet) to `Capacitor_THT:C_Disc_D3.0mm_W1.6mm_P2.50mm`, in the schematic and on the board. On the board keep each part's pad 1 where it is and its rotation, and keep every connection: re-route whatever the shorter parts leave unconnected. DRC must stay clean (no violations, no unconnected items). Change nothing else, and save.

Hubble_DK.kicad_pcb in this folder is an 8-layer board part way through routing. Route these four debugger nets, which are not routed yet: Net-(U9-B1) (U9 pad 10 to R15), Net-(U9-B2) (U9 pad 9 to R16), Net-(U9-B3) (U9 pad 8 to R17) and /Debugger/DBG_LS_OE (U9 pad 12 to R18 and the copper already on that net), at their net class's track width or wider. Don't touch anything else and don't add DRC violations; save the board.
